feeds.title: Ukulele Hunt Blog
feeds.description: Ukulele Hunt is the number one Ukulele website. Ukulele Hunt is all about Ukulele Tabs, Tips, Chords and News Online.

feeds.title: Got A Ukulele
feeds.description: Got A Ukulele is a leading ukulele reviews blog including beginners tips, chords and clear advice guides. It is the the leading resource for ukulele beginners.

feeds.title: Ukulele Tricks Blog
feeds.description: Ukulele Tricks provides Ukulele lessons for beginners & beyond so you can learn how to play ukulele. Follow this blog to find ukulele songs, chords, tuning information and other uke tips.

feeds.title: GOT A UKULELE
feeds.description: Leading ukulele and musical instrument review blog including beginners tips, chords and clear advice guides for uke players.

feeds.title: Ukuleles Unanimous Blog
feeds.description: Ukuleles Unanimous is simply for people who unanimously love playing the ukulele. Our mission is to spread the joy of playing ukulele to as many people as possible. Let's play!

feeds.title: Ukulelia
feeds.description: Ukulelia is a blog that provides news about ukuleles and ukulele music.

feeds.title: Lichty Guitars
feeds.description: Luthier Jay Lichty handcrafts custom acoustic guitars and ukuleles from the finest quality materials.

feeds.title: Ukulele Play
feeds.description: Ukulele Play is a website that provides articles related to ukulele learning, reviews, art, performances, fun finds & more.

feeds.title: Humble Baritonics
feeds.description: Humble Baritonics is all about Baritone Ukulele Studies.

feeds.title: ukestuff
feeds.description: Ukulele in secondary music education.

feeds.title: KAMUKE Magazine Blog
feeds.description: Founded in Sydney, Australia in 2011, KAMUKE is a high-quality, hard-copy magazine produced by ukulele players for ukulele players. An entertaining mix of features, interviews, reviews, playing tips and historical articles, it's the only publication of its kind in the world, and it fits inside a ukulele case

feeds.title: Flea Plucker
feeds.description: Flea Plucker is a ukulele blog. I run the 'Ukulele Utopia Daily' paper.

feeds.title: Jupiter Ukulele Jonathan Dale Blog
feeds.description: Jonathan Dale hand builds ukuleles primarily with 'local' wood from Eastern Pennsylvania. Great sounding instruments, that are also beautiful objects.

feeds.title: Argapa Ukuleles
feeds.description: Argapa Ukuleles is not a manufacturer comparable to bigger and well known brands. This is my building diary. I build ukuleles in my apartment workshop.

feeds.title: Griffin Ukuleles Blog
feeds.description: Griffin Ukuleles is really a one man band. Just one old guy who loves woodworking and discovered the joy of the ukulele pretty late in life. A few years back I discovered the ukulele and my fascination and obsession began. After I had made a few, and joined the local ukulele society B.U.G. (Bellingham Ukulele Group). Building ukuleles is a labor of love for me.

feeds.title: Hull Ukulele Group
feeds.description: The Hull Ukulele Group came about as an excuse to go to the pub, but the plan backfired when 15 people turned up at the first meeting. Over a few beers, some crisps, and a Johnny Cash song, the Hull Ukulele Group was born. They regularly perform around Hull & East Yorkshire, where we have become a popular fixture at local events and festivals, including the Clipper Race, Ella Street Festival etc.

feeds.title: UkeAlong Blog
feeds.description: UkeAlong is a website for ukulele players featuring play-along videos with onscreen chords or tablature and chord overview pages with fretboard charts to help with learning how to play chords in different inversions across the fretboard of the ukulele.

feeds.title: Ukulele.io Blog
feeds.description: Whether you're looking for advice, new ukulele music to play, or some fantastic tracks that feature the ukulele, Ukulele.io has it all. Jenny Peters and Rebecca Bogart, also known as the Ukulele Sisters, have over seventy years of combined music teaching experience.

feeds.title: Ukulele Go
feeds.description: My name is Dave. started Ukulele Go back in November 2014 after my wife bought me a ukulele. I struggled with it so I started this site to log everything that I was learning and provide a bit of an outlet for me to scribble down my thoughts. Over time Ukulele Go has grown, as has my ukulele collection.

feeds.title: Ukulele Mike Lynch
feeds.description: Mike is a musician, composer and music educator from the Seattle, Washington area. I've been teaching for over 45 years. Guitar, Choral, Keyboard, Guitar, Ukulele and General Music.

feeds.title: Ukesong
feeds.description: Ukesong is your true source to find the most viewed uke videos anywhere on the internet. It is the place to visit after you have learned the basics and want to do more with your uke. If you want to be amazed at what a ukulele can do in the hands of masters, watch their videos.

feeds.title: Renaissance Ukulele
feeds.description: This blog is the record of a learning voyage. I have long been intrigued by Renaissance music, and am slowly learning more about it. I am trying to get to grips with the tenor ukulele, which is not dissimilar to the Renaissance guitar.

feeds.title: Ukulele Blog 808
feeds.description: Ukulele information Blog. I like smooth jazz music in particular, and I like Paul Hardcastle, Kool, and Klein, Peter White, Earl Klugh, just to name a few...

feeds.title: Red Bluff Ukulele Club
feeds.description: Founded on April 4, 2010, Kukana's Uke Klub / KUK started with a small group of friends in a little Tiki Hut in the back yard of founder, Susan 'Kukana' Matthews. This awesome little club is for beginning to intermediate players and anyone interested in learning more (or teaching others) about that wonderful little instrument, the ukulele.

feeds.title: Cutie Circle Blog
feeds.description: Led by ukulele enthusiasts Jen Chang and Harvey Soon, we are a bunch of fun-loving people who all share the joy of playing the friendly ukulele (aka uke) in a song circle normally on the second Sunday of every month at the Evergreen Cultural Centre in Coquitlam.

feeds.title: Remembering His Grace with a Ukulele
feeds.description: A blog dedicated to providing chords for Jesus-exalting worship songs on the ukulele.

feeds.title: The Original Ukulele Songs Blog
feeds.description: The Original Ukulele Songs platform is created by Nick Cody. This site is a platform for original ukulele based songs and is unique in that it brings together ukulele artists from all over the globe.

feeds.title: Ukulele Music Info
feeds.description: Ukulele Music Info is the leading site for all things ukulele related. This website includes reviews, guides, resources, accessories and more. They've gathered the top guides, recommendations and info in one place.

feeds.title: Live Ukulele
feeds.description: Live Ukulele is a huge resource of tabs, lessons, reviews, and more for beginning to advanced players. My name is Brad Bordessa and I play the 'ukulele. I love teaching music to people from all walks of life. That's why I created Live 'Ukulele.com - to teach everyone how to play the 'ukulele for free.

feeds.title: Ukulele Underground Blog
feeds.description: Ukulele Underground is one of the fastest growing ukulele communities on the internet. Learn to play the ukulele at your own pace with our step-by-step approach from the best teachers in the world.

feeds.title: Ukulele Magazine
feeds.description: For uke players and enthusiasts, Ukulele captures the playful spirit of a vibrant community. Ukulele visits today's players, festivals, and clubs and revisits the pioneers who spread the joy of uke.

feeds.title: Eat My Uke
feeds.description: I am a UK-based music and video creator using the ukulele to explore the world of music. A prolific and versatile creator, my Top 50 albums project saw me arranging, learning and performing medleys of classic albums, one a week for a whole year.

feeds.title: Ukuleles Unanimous Blog
feeds.description: Find out more about how to play the ukulele with our free resources, chords, lessons, and ukulele next steps.

feeds.title: Southern Ukulele Store Blog
feeds.description: Southern Ukulele Store are passionate about ukuleles and our mission is to spread the ukulele bug far and wide.
